handwritten_retrieval.description: UCI Multiple Features Handwritten cross-view retrieval (Table 1): retrieve the pixel-average view from the Karhunen-Loeve view (K2P) and back (P2K) among 400 held-out pairs in an 8-dimensional shared space, with only 100 known training pairs. Results are the paper's Table 1 numbers.

k2p_r@1.description: Exact coefficient-to-pixel nearest-neighbor retrieval catches methods that only place the true pair somewhere in the top ten.

k2p_r@5.description: Coefficient-to-pixel recall at five measures tighter retrieval quality than the headline top-ten metric.

k2p_r@10.description: Coefficient-to-pixel recall at ten follows the paper's retrieval-style benefit metric.

p2k_r@1.description: Exact pixel-to-coefficient nearest-neighbor retrieval checks that the shared representation works in the reverse direction.

p2k_r@5.description: Pixel-to-coefficient recall at five measures reverse-direction retrieval before the broader top-ten cutoff.

p2k_r@10.description: Pixel-to-coefficient recall at ten prevents one-direction-only improvements from dominating the score.

mean_r@10.description: Average bidirectional recall at ten is the primary cross-view retrieval benefit metric.

mean_mrr.description: Average bidirectional reciprocal rank rewards placing the true pair near the top instead of merely inside the recall window.

mean_median_rank.description: Average bidirectional median true-pair rank penalizes methods with poor typical ranking despite acceptable recall cutoffs.

paper_setting.note: Paper: 100 known pairs, 1900 unpaired samples (Table 12), 400 held-out test pairs, 8-dimensional CCA output.

gym_setting.note: Scaled split of the 2000 UCI rows (stratified, fixed): 400 hidden test pairs (the paper's test size and gallery), 400 public development pairs for the train-side score, and 1200 training rows = 100 known pairs + 1100 unpaired rows thinned 10% per view (990 unpaired rows per view, Appendix E.7). The paper's Handwritten unpaired pool is larger (1900), so absolute recall is expected below the paper's. The 100-pair budget, the 8-D operating point and the 400-pair gallery are enforced by the data interface and the evaluator, not scored.
